snippets.title: Incoterms basics for Bangladesh importers (informal summary)
snippets.heading_path: Incoterms basics for Bangladesh importers (informal summary) > FOB (Free On Board)
snippets.content:
FOB (Free On Board)
Under FOB, the seller delivers the goods on board the vessel at the named Chinese port, for example Shanghai or Ningbo. The seller handles export clearance. The buyer arranges and pays main sea freight and insurance. Risk passes when the goods are on board. FOB is very common for Bangladesh importers because they can choose their freight forwarder.

snippets.title: Bangladesh Bank — import advance payment (summary)
snippets.heading_path: Bangladesh Bank — import advance payment (summary) > What this means for an importer
snippets.content:
What this means for an importer
- Keep each advance at or below the limit unless your bank approves another route.
- Plan for the bill of entry: keep the invoice, packing list and bill of lading ready.
- Ask your AD bank about the matching period for each advance.
- For larger orders, ask about an LC or a bank guarantee.
- Use staged payments so you do not pay everything before shipment.
- Treat this page as a starting point only. Verify with the official circular.

snippets.content:
Export-credit-insured supplier terms
Here the supplier ships on open account, meaning you pay later, and the supplier's export-credit insurance covers non-payment. The demo option from Silk Route Cover is 90 days with about 1.2% flat cost passed on. The minimum is USD 3,000. It requires at least two completed deals with the supplier and a verified supplier. Collateral is the supplier's insurance policy.

snippets.title: Financing glossary and how Setu ranks options
snippets.heading_path: Financing glossary and how Setu ranks options > Effective annual rate
snippets.content:
Effective annual rate
Effective annual rate means the yearly cost of money so you can compare options. A flat fee or price markup is not a yearly rate. To compare, take the total extra cost, divide it by the amount financed, and scale it to a year by the number of days of credit. A shorter credit period makes the same flat percentage cost more per year. Setu calculates this in deterministic code and shows total cost in BDT as well.
